error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.
error.Network.Unavailable: Couldn't reach the server. Try again in a moment.
error.Request.Malformed: The request is not in a valid format.
error.Auth.InvalidCredentials: The username or password is incorrect.
error.Auth.Unauthenticated: Your session is invalid or expired. Sign in again.
error.Auth.Forbidden: Your user is not allowed to perform this operation.
error.Idempotency.KeyRequired: The request is missing its idempotency key. Reload the page and try again.
error.Idempotency.KeyTooLong: The idempotency key can't be longer than 100 characters.
error.Idempotency.KeyReused: This form was already submitted with different data. Reload the page and try again.
error.Idempotency.RequestInProgress: The same operation is still being processed. Wait a moment and try again.
error.Query.InvalidPageNumber: The page number must be 1 or greater.
error.Query.InvalidPageSize: The page size must be between 1 and 100.
error.Query.InvalidSortBy: You can't sort by that field.
error.Query.InvalidSortDirection: The sort order must be ascending or descending.
error.Query.InvalidStatus: The match status is not valid.
error.Query.InvalidDateRange: The start date can't be after the end date.
error.Team.NameTooLong: The team name can't be longer than 100 characters.
error.Team.CountryTooLong: The team country can't be longer than 60 characters.
error.Team.NotFound: The team doesn't exist or was deleted.
error.Team.HasActiveMatches: A team with scheduled or in-progress matches can't be deleted.
error.Player.NameTooLong: The player name can't be longer than 100 characters.
error.Player.InvalidShirtNumber: The shirt number must be between 1 and 99.
error.Player.ShirtNumberTaken: Shirt number {shirtNumber} already belongs to another player on the team.
error.Player.NotFound: The player doesn't exist on this team.
error.Goal.InvalidMinute: The goal minute must be between 1 and 120.
error.Goal.NotFound: The goal doesn't exist in this match.
error.Match.SameTeams: A team can't play against itself.
error.Match.ScheduledAtRequired: The match date and time is required.
error.Match.GoalsRequired: The list of goals is required; it can be empty.
error.Match.CorrectionReasonRequired: The reason for the correction is required.
error.Match.CorrectionReasonTooLong: The reason for the correction can't be longer than 500 characters.
error.Match.NotFound: The match doesn't exist or was deleted.
error.Match.ScheduleConflict: One of the teams already has a match on {scheduledAt}.
error.Match.PlayerNotInMatch: The player doesn't belong to either team in the match.
error.Match.InvalidStatusTransition: A match that is “{currentStatus}” can't change to “{targetStatus}”.
error.Match.NotScheduled: Only a match that hasn't started can be rescheduled (this one is “{currentStatus}”).
error.Match.NotInProgress: Goals can only be registered or annulled in a match in progress (this one is “{currentStatus}”).
error.Match.NotFinished: Only the result of a finished match can be corrected (this one is “{currentStatus}”).
error.Match.CannotDelete: Only a scheduled or cancelled match can be deleted (this one is “{currentStatus}”).
